item.title: Google Hash Code 2022
item.description:
Google Hash Code is a team programming competition that lasts about 4 hours, in which a solution to multiple inputs of a problem must be given, points are given depending on how good it is. Not happy enought with the result we got during our last attempt at this competition we decided to try again.

The problem

In 2022 a list of contributors (with mastered skills) and a list of projects with different skill requirements were given. Contributors could improve their skills by completing projects and can mentor each other to work is roles in which they couldn’t succeed on their own. The task was to assign the contributors to project roles that fit them and maximize the score for completed projects.

item.title: Google Hash Code 2021
item.description:
Google Hash Code is a team programming competition that lasts about 4 hours, in which a solution to multiple inputs of a problem must be given, points are given depending on how good it is.

The problem

In 2021 a city road network was given and planned paths for all cars in it, we had to optimize the schedule of traffic lights to minimize the total amount of time spent and help as many cars as possible reach their destination.
